title: Closed Gates Leak: Decomposing Adjacent-Layer Cancellation in Gated Language Models
summary: Across ten gated models closed-gate neurons carry most of the average damping; annealing their negative activation side removes damping/cancellation in tested continued training. Sixteen language models are analyzed, including ten gated models; counterfactual and continued-training controls test mechanism, with limited small-model interventions.
